description: Agent Limits: submit one cap shared by several agents or tasks (one wallet, budget or quota, with its amount and period), how spending against it is counted (in one place, per agent or nowhere, updated in real time, in batches or at period end, and whether each spend is checked and reserved against the shared count in one step before money moves), each agent drawing on it with what it reads its remaining room from (the shared count, its own estimate or nothing) and the most it can spend before its view refreshes, and any spending recorded against the cap in one period. The signed report says whether the cap is accounted in one place in real time, names every way agents can drain it in parallel (no shared count, a lagging count, an agent reading its own estimate, checking and spending in separate steps), gives how far the total can pass the cap from the agents’ in-flight room, and names recorded spending over the cap, with the fix for each. This reads how one cap is counted across agents: whether a budget has its controls is wever_budget-controls-check, what a cap aggregates over is wever_exposure-cap-check and one request against one budget is wever_agent-budget-guard. Verdict cap_overshot, cap_can_overshoot, accounting_unverified or accounted_in_one_place. POST /api/shared-cap-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.
